scope: Compare four pool/reservation configurations against one unchanged, hot DB.
fixture: same unchanged full-seed DB; fixed 32 article lookups, no writes
caveats: Fixed hot read set is not the challenge mix or a capacity score.
PostgreSQL persists across variants to remove fixture/cache-order differences.
Client and server share the existing container; client CPU and PG task I/O counters are retained.
ZFS disk I/O may not be attributed in per-task read_bytes; that counter is not proof of zero storage waits.
source_note: Repository Go driver received gofmt only after measurement; measured source retained as hot-read-measured.go.
